title: Right to Return of Seized or Produced Documents

content.scenario: A customer's documents were seized by a regulatory body. After 20 days, the customer requested the return of the documents. The customer received the documents back, including the original copies and certified extracts.
content.outcome: The customer received the documents back, including the original copies and certified extracts.
